sloka: रामं शुश्रूष भद्रं ते सुमित्रानन्दवर्धन ।रामः सर्वस्य लोकस्य शुभेष्वभिरतः सदा ।। ६.१२२.३० ।।
transliteration: rāmaṁ śuśrūṣa bhadraṁ te sumitrānandavardhana ।rāmaḥ sarvasya lokasya śubheṣvabhirataḥ sadā ।। 6.122.30 ।।

translations.english: "O Lakshmana, the enhancer of Sumithra's joy, 'Be auspicious. Rama will always remain good in the service of the three worlds."
